notes: Compressor sits on the floor off-table (SHI F-20L/FA-20L or Leybold Coolpak 2000e, water-cooled 46x45x57 cm / 73 kg) and connects through 3.3 m helium flex lines; the Cryostation is mounted at 45 deg or 90 deg to the optical-table hole pattern. Cooling tower (GM cryocooler in a vertical aluminium cylinder) is linked to the sample chamber by a baseplate and semi-rigid bellows. Chamber stack from inside out: sample platform (stage 2) -> radiation shield with 30 mm cold windows (stage 1) -> lift-off upper vacuum housing with 50 mm warm windows (4 side + 1 top, 27.4 deg full acceptance angle, AR-coated fused silica); bosses around the windows on the CA-100 housing. Cooling power 90 mW at 4.2 K, cooldown ~3 h, vibration <15 nm p-p, 25 DC + 4 RF standard. Removing a cold window adds 50-100 mW heat load per window (manual). Rack electronics: 4U system control unit (43x38x17 cm) and 6U vacuum control unit with integrated roughing pump (43x38x26.5 cm).
